description: Saves a pitch draft from what you know about the founders and returns a private link. The founders open it, review every answer, and send it themselves. Leave unknown fields empty; never invent.

agentContact.description: Name and email of who sends the agent's access token

agentScope.description: What that agent may answer (metrics, usage, pipeline)

agentUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the company's own MCP server, if any

builtTogether.description: What the founders have built or survived together before, and how long they have known each other

call.description: The first three people they call, and what they ask them

cut.description: What they cut first, and what they never cut

deck.description: Link to a deck or demo

fulltime.description: One of: Full time, Part time, Joining at funding

known.description: Their unfair advantage: what they know or have done that almost nobody else has

frustration.description: The personal frustration behind the company: the day, the place, what happened. First person.

hardest.description: The founders' hardest disagreement and how it ended

language.description: Language the answers are written in, so the founders open the matching version of the site

monday.description: Scenario: 7 weeks of cash left and the round fell through. What the founders do today, in order.

oneliner.description: What the company does, in one sentence

raising.description: Amount and instrument being raised, e.g. €600k BSA AIR

runway.description: Months of runway today, as a number

stage.description: One of: Idea, Pre-seed, Seed, Later

teamSize.description: Number of people on the team today

videoLink.description: Link to a 90-second founder video, if one exists

whyNow.description: Why this is possible now and not five years ago

whyYou.description: Why this team and not a bigger team with more money

worstWeek.description: Optional: the worst week a founder has lived

name: draft_pitch
title: Draft a pitch
